Hi all — Mina from Redwood Security. Thanks for the invite. Quick clarifications before the meeting so we can prepare:

1) SOC 2 scope: our SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted Redwood API and our control environment for customer data in the hosted offering. For the Private deployment we provide guidance and a checklist — the customer is responsible for the environment; we integrate with customer-managed KMS where required. I'll bring the exact language and a redacted SOC 2 summary to the session.

2) Encryption: we support encryption at rest in both Hosted and Private patterns; details depend on underlying storage and KMS — I'll outline options (Redwood-managed vs customer-managed KMS).

3) Evidence & pre-reads: I've attached a worked answers file with common questions we expect (security-answers-arcadia.xlsx). If Arcadia can provide current network diagrams and expected traffic patterns ahead of time that would help.

Can we finalize the meeting as Wed Mar 17, 13:00–14:00 PDT (Google Meet)? Also, please confirm any procurement agenda items so we can allocate time.

Thanks — Mina
